details.description: gpt-oss-20b is OpenAI's 20-billion-parameter open-weight language model, released August 5, 2025 alongside the larger gpt-oss-120b, under the Apache 2.0 license. It is a Mixture-of-Experts model with about 21 billion total parameters and roughly 3.6 billion active parameters per token, using MXFP4 quantization so it runs within 16GB of memory; OpenAI positions it for lower-latency, local, or specialized deployment rather than gpt-oss-120b's production use case. It shares the same three configurable reasoning-effort levels (low, medium, high), full chain-of-thought access, and agentic tool use (function calling, web browsing, Python code execution, structured outputs), within a 128K-token context window.
advantages: Scores 58.6% on GPQA Diamond, rising to 67.1% with tools at medium reasoning effort (OpenAI gpt-oss-20b model card).
Scores 53.2% on SWE-bench Verified at medium reasoning effort (OpenAI gpt-oss-20b model card).
Runs within 16GB of memory via MXFP4 quantization and is fine-tunable on consumer hardware (OpenAI gpt-oss-20b model card).
Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license with no copyleft restrictions (OpenAI gpt-oss-20b model card / GitHub repo).
disadvantages: Text-only: no image or audio input or output support.
Scores lower than the larger gpt-oss-120b sibling on benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond (58.6% vs 80.8%), in exchange for lower latency and a smaller memory footprint.
